Hand-written. A reply in an HTML compose window in Paragraph mode, as the editor holds it when the reply is opened (no serializer indentation). The structure is the capture's (captured/mail_html_compose_signature_quote_text.txt):

paragraphs, an empty


, div.moz-cite-prefix with the a.moz-txt-link-abbreviated and a trailing
, blockquote type=cite holding pre.moz-quote-pre, div.moz-signature with '--
'. Added by hand to the captured text: a non-breaking space in the greeting (spec 03 'Newline contract of the compose placeholders'), a Shift+Enter
inside a paragraph, and a second quoted line.
